Just outside Heraklion, Crete's capital city, the Candia Maris is a Now Live sprawling beachside resort spanning nearly 10 acres. Although the property lacks the charm of smaller hotels, it more than compensates with its amenities, which include tennis courts and seven pools. The highlight is the vast thalassotherapy spa, which underwent a
multimillion-dollar renovation in 2008.
